name: TU Crypto Widgets
author: tuwidgets

sections.description:
TU Widgets seamlessly integrate into your WordPress environment, allowing you to enrich posts and pages with real-time data without any technical overhead.

TU Widgets are designed specifically for WordPress publishers, enabling you to add live price charts, market quotes, and analytics directly into your content. This helps transform static articles into interactive and engaging experiences.

The widgets are fully responsive, easy to embed via shortcodes or blocks, and optimized for fast loading. They update automatically in real time, ensuring your audience always sees up-to-date information without manual maintenance.

Whether you run a blog, news site, or educational platform, TU Widgets help increase user engagement, improve content depth, and keep visitors on your site longer.

Features

  • Real-time data updates: Display live market data, including price movements, trends, and overall market activity.
  • Easy integration: Quick setup using an embed code without complex development.
  • Responsive design: Works seamlessly across mobile and desktop devices.
  • Customizable widgets: Adapt layout and parameters to match your website structure.
  • Multiple widget types: Quotes ticker, market news, price forecasts, and technical analysis.
  • Performance optimized: Fast loading and seamless integration without affecting site speed.

Available Widgets

Quotes Ticker

A live feed of price updates reflecting current market dynamics. It allows users to monitor multiple assets simultaneously and stay aligned with fast-moving market conditions.

Market News

A continuously updated stream of financial news and insights. It keeps users informed about key events, macroeconomic developments, and market-moving factors.

Price Forecasts

Forward-looking insights presenting possible market scenarios across different time horizons. This widget helps users better understand potential trends and supports decision-making.

Technical Analysis

A comprehensive market overview combining key technical indicators into a single gauge. It helps users quickly interpret signals and make more informed trading decisions.

Each widget helps users better understand market conditions and make informed decisions directly on your website.

Use Cases

  • Financial blogs: Enrich articles with real-time market data, charts, and insights.
  • Affiliate websites: Increase conversions with interactive tools that help users compare and decide.
  • Crypto and Forex platforms: Provide live market context, including price movements and trends.
  • Educational resources: Support learning with visual tools explaining market behavior.
  • Trading communities: Enhance discussions with live data, analytics, and up-to-date information.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Go to the Plugins menu and click “Add New”.
  3. Search for “TU Crypto Widgets”.
  4. Click “Install Now” and wait for the installation to complete.
  5. Click “Activate” to enable the plugin.
  6. After activation, use shortcodes or blocks to add widgets to your pages and posts.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file from WordPress.org.
  2. Unzip the archive on your computer.
  3. Upload the tu-crypto-widgets folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  4. Go to the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  5. Find “TU Crypto Widgets” and click “Activate”.
  6. Use shortcodes or blocks to embed widgets into your content.
sections.faq:
How do I add a widget to a post or page?

You can add TU Widgets using a shortcode or Gutenberg block.

Example shortcode:
[tucrwi_crypto_widget type=”ticker” id=”widget-id”]

Simply paste it into any post, page, or widget area.

What types of widgets are available?

TU Widgets includes a variety of financial widgets such as price tickers, market news, forecasts, and technical analysis tools.

Does the plugin support cryptocurrency and Forex data?

Yes, TU Widgets supports both cryptocurrency and Forex markets, allowing you to display real-time financial data for a wide range of assets.

Do the widgets update in real time and affect performance?

Yes, all widgets update automatically in real time and are optimized to load asynchronously with minimal impact on performance.

Is the plugin easy to use and suitable for non-developers?

Yes, no coding skills are required. You can easily add and configure widgets using shortcodes or Gutenberg blocks.

What external services does this plugin use?

This plugin embeds cryptocurrency widgets provided by Traders Union (TU) on WordPress websites using shortcodes.

The widgets are rendered using an external JavaScript file loaded from:
https://tradersunion.com/widgets/quotes/client/tu-widgets-quotes.js

When a widget is displayed, widget configuration parameters (such as widget type, selected assets, and language) are sent to the Traders Union service to retrieve widget data. Standard technical request data such as IP address and user-agent may also be transmitted.

Service provider:
Traders Union (IAFT LTD) — https://tradersunion.com/widgets/

Privacy Policy:
https://tradersunion.com/privacy-policy/

Terms of Use:
https://tradersunion.com/terms-of-use/

Where can I see a live demo of the widgets?

You can view a demo here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1CkbbmC9lKU

Live demo page:
https://tradersunion.com/widgets/live-demo/
